  if (l == null || l.isEmpty) return [];
  
  final seen = <int>{};
  final result = <int>[];
  
  for (final item in l) {
    if (!seen.contains(item)) {
      seen.add(item);

  }

}

List<int> maximum(List<int> arr, int k) {
  if (arr.isEmpty || k <= 0) return [];
  
  final n = arr.length;
  final result = List<int>.filled(n - k + 1, 0);
  
  for (int i = 0; i < n - k + 1; i++) {
    var maxVal = arr[i];
    var windowStart = i;
    while (windowStart < i + k) {
      if (arr[windowStart] > maxVal) {
        maxVal = arr[windowStart];
      }
      windowStart++;
    }
    result[i] = maxVal;
  }
  
  return result;
}
